Licences

Segoe MDL2 Assets: a Windows system font. It can be used by name in the app on Windows, but its font file can't be bundled or redistributed, and it doesn't exist on macOS or Linux.

Fluent System Icons: MIT licence, © Microsoft Corporation. The SVGs can be bundled with the app on any platform; the licence text goes in the credits.
